label: Gate capacitance in the linear region
section: Gate capacitance in the linear region
subgoals: Compute the intrinsic gate-channel capacitance W L C_ox
Split it evenly between source and drain
Add the overlap capacitance per edge

label: Gate capacitance in saturation
subgoals: Assign two thirds of W L C_ox to the source in saturation
Leave only the overlap term on the drain
Contrast Meyer capacitances with charge-based models

label: The Miller effect
subgoals: Compute C_gs and C_gd for the operating region
Multiply C_gd by one plus the gain magnitude
Sum to get the effective input capacitance
